The draft mentions the alternative in notes. OWNER DECISION.

issues.where: yasya syād āyurārogyaṃ vittaṃ sa bahuśo aśnute
issues.problem: Alternative parse that removes the unstated object: syāt closes the relative clause ("for whom [the above] occurs") and āyurārogyam vittam are the ACCUSATIVE objects of aśnute: "he for whom [these] occur obtains life-and-health [or life, health] and wealth, often". This fits the adopted aśnute better than the draft parse (āyuḥ nominative with no object). Translation kept as drafted. OWNER DECISION.

patch.text: Alternative parse: 'yasya syāt' may close the relative clause (the items of 50-52 occur for him), with 'āyur-ārogyaṃ vittam' as accusative objects of 'aśnute' ('he obtains life, health and wealth, often'); this would give aśnute an object and fits the adopted conjecture. Translation kept as drafted; owner to decide.

summary: 34 units reviewed word by word against the printed Devanagari (no IAST ai/au hiatus problems: counts of ै/ौ match in all 34 lines). No identification judged wrong (śālmalī, kiṃśuka standard; kovidāra, pāribhadraka, vetra, śaṣkulī correctly probable and hedged in both languages); all four adopted typo conjectures (patya, nadan hadodadhīn, aśrute, tvilān) are kept out of src, flagged, and marked 'on a conjectural reading' in both translations; viśāmiṣa and sarpaṣānamivarṇān correctly unsplit/unclear. Dream omens translated as written; nothing softened. Findings: 0 errors; minor: unflagged missing-space tokens (u35 x9, 52, 60, 65, 67), supplied 'and' (u55, u58), Hindi slips (u35 srotasā case, abhyajyate, dust-pillow; u50 दिशा; u58 śobhana), u37 not matching the glossary rendering of bhavanti cātra, u41 gram labels, u43 w su-acchān, u35 hriyate, u49 metre claim in flag, plus owner decisions without patch (puṣpāḍhya scope, āyatana scope, vakram/vaktram, aśnāti scope, u53 parse with āyurārogyam as object of aśnute, u59 āktān agreement). No regrouping needed; groupings in the draft look sound.
glossary_suggestions: bhavanti cātra: Hindi 'और इस विषय में ये हैं:' / English 'And on this matter there are:' (one form book-wide; siblings vary).
Missing printed space where no sandhi applies (including ṃ before a consonant): flag per token, split in words (applied p02 ch12 k2).
srotasā hriyate (carried off by a current) not srotasā āhriyate; abhyajyate = अभ्यंग किया जाता है (not लेप).
Hindi śobhana = शोभन यानी अच्छे, kept apart from śubha = शुभ.
sāvitrī (homa verse) = the Sāvitrī/Gāyatrī verse (standard); kaṣāya-vāsas = ochre-coloured garments (colour, not taste).
OPEN (owner): puṣpāḍhya scope in u35 list of trees; āyatana scope; u53 parse; u59 āktān agreement; damaged-word rule conflict (unclear vs guess in translation) still undecided.
